name: Elek (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Elek (a crowned shield of red, white and blue with yellow eagle supporters and mantling) above the name ELEK in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Elek arms with crown, supporters and mantling
